stage: development prototype and external coverage audit; not confirmation
selection: One common alpha selected by strict TRAIN drug-macro held-gene MSE of response-only sparse model. Tie: larger alpha. No target annotations used for hyperparameter selection.
model: Nonnegative weighted Lasso on genetic-library-mean-centered signatures, with fixed query-independent chemical-training mean background (leave-own-parent-out for train). Intercept, dictionary RMS and response RMS estimated on fit genes only. DTA percentile penalty weights are [1+2*(1-rank)] normalized to mean one. Coefficients are response contributions, not occupancy or causal effects.
gene_holdout: 20 complete-linkage modules from genetic TRAIN library gene correlations; modules allocated deterministically to five balanced folds. Same folds across methods/queries per cell. Internal feature holdout, not independent experiment.
retrieval: Full-gene fit after alpha freezing; rank nonnegative standardized contributions, zero coefficients tied. Existing source annotation positives only; unknown is not negative. Development endpoint only.
external_policy: Metadata/structure/assay coverage and historical exposure audit only. No external model scores, external label-driven tuning or new test expression scoring. Final confirmation cohort requires separate freeze after feasibility.
scope: Computational-only; old 59 compounds are exposed development material. Old train/val split retained, old test excluded from prototype. Historical upstream encoder exposure not fully excluded.
